scopeReview: CED FUN-1.C.1–3 Extreme Value Theorem, local versus global extrema and critical points. Attainment distinguished from bounds, sufficient theorem conditions from necessary conditions, and derivative failure on the domain from holes outside it. Endpoint/local-extremum convention ambiguity avoided.
varietyReview: EVT existence versus uniqueness, bounded open interval, unbounded reciprocal, defined corner minimum, stationary non-extremum, missing-domain hole, polynomial critical roots, original local/global graph, constant extrema, discontinuous-but-attained extrema and an interior differentiable maximum.
repetitionReview: Each prompt and all four options were read separately; distinct tasks/contexts within this set. Cross-topic exact duplicates checked by validator. Semantic similarity and AP difficulty remain judgment calls, not proven by an automated score.
